require open emdash.emdash3_2;
protected symbol ts_family (K : Cat) : τ (Catd K) ≔ @Const_catd K Terminal_cat;
protected symbol ts_section_cat (K : Cat) (x : τ (Obj K)) : Cat
 ≔ @Homd_target_section_cat K (ts_family K) x;
protected symbol ts_section (K : Cat) (x : τ (Obj K)) : τ (Obj (ts_section_cat K x))
 ≔ @homd_src_sec K (ts_family K) (ts_family K) (@id_funcd K (ts_family K)) x Terminal_obj;
protected symbol ts_current (K : Cat) (x : τ (Obj K))
 : τ (Functor Terminal_cat (Op_cat (ts_section_cat K x)))
 ≔ @homd_src_func K (ts_family K) (ts_family K) (@id_funcd K (ts_family K)) x;
protected symbol ts_constant (K : Cat) (x : τ (Obj K))
 : τ (Functor Terminal_cat (Op_cat (ts_section_cat K x)))
 ≔ @Obj_func (Op_cat (ts_section_cat K x)) (ts_section K x);
protected symbol ts_tgt (K : Cat) (x y : τ (Obj K))
 : τ (Functor Terminal_cat (Homd_index_cat (Hom_cat K x y)))
 ≔ @homd_tgt_func K (ts_family K) (ts_family K) (@id_funcd K (ts_family K)) x Terminal_obj y;
protected symbol ts_value (K : Cat) (x y : τ (Obj K))
 : τ (Obj (Homd_index_cat (Hom_cat K x y)))
 ≔ @fapp0 Terminal_cat (Homd_index_cat (Hom_cat K x y)) (ts_tgt K x y) Terminal_obj;
protected symbol ts_current_map (K : Cat) (x y : τ (Obj K))
 (h : τ (Hom Terminal_cat Terminal_obj Terminal_obj)) (f : τ (Hom K x y))
 : τ (Functor Terminal_cat Terminal_cat)
 ≔ @tapp0_fapp0 (Hom_cat K x y) (Op_cat Cat_cart)
     (ts_value K x y) (ts_value K x y) f
     (@tapp0_fapp0 Terminal_cat (Homd_index_cat (Hom_cat K x y))
       (ts_tgt K x y) (ts_tgt K x y) Terminal_obj
       (@strict_transfor Terminal_cat (Homd_index_cat (Hom_cat K x y))
         (ts_tgt K x y) (ts_tgt K x y)
         (@tapp0_hom_fapp0 K Homd_coeff_cat
           (@Homd_coeff_diagram K (ts_family K))
           (@Homd_coeff_diagram K (@hom_ K K (@id_func K) x))
           (ts_section K x) (ts_section K x) y
           (@fapp1_fapp0 Terminal_cat (Op_cat (ts_section_cat K x))
             (ts_current K x) Terminal_obj Terminal_obj h))));
protected symbol ts_constant_map (K : Cat) (x y : τ (Obj K))
 (h : τ (Hom Terminal_cat Terminal_obj Terminal_obj)) (f : τ (Hom K x y))
 : τ (Functor Terminal_cat Terminal_cat)
 ≔ @tapp0_fapp0 (Hom_cat K x y) (Op_cat Cat_cart)
     (ts_value K x y) (ts_value K x y) f
     (@tapp0_fapp0 Terminal_cat (Homd_index_cat (Hom_cat K x y))
       (ts_tgt K x y) (ts_tgt K x y) Terminal_obj
       (@strict_transfor Terminal_cat (Homd_index_cat (Hom_cat K x y))
         (ts_tgt K x y) (ts_tgt K x y)
         (@tapp0_hom_fapp0 K Homd_coeff_cat
           (@Homd_coeff_diagram K (ts_family K))
           (@Homd_coeff_diagram K (@hom_ K K (@id_func K) x))
           (ts_section K x) (ts_section K x) y
           (@fapp1_fapp0 Terminal_cat (Op_cat (ts_section_cat K x))
             (ts_constant K x) Terminal_obj Terminal_obj h))));

// Preserve the actual selected precomposition normal form (its inverse
// cancellation is a separate existing pre/post normalization boundary).
assert [K : Cat] (x y : τ (Obj K)) (f : τ (Hom K x y))
 (i : τ (@DefIso Terminal_cat Terminal_obj Terminal_obj)) ⊢
 @fapp0 Terminal_cat Terminal_cat
   (ts_current_map K x y (@defiso_to Terminal_cat Terminal_obj Terminal_obj i) f)
   (@defiso_from Terminal_cat Terminal_obj Terminal_obj i)
 ≡ @hom_precomp_along_fapp0 Terminal_cat Terminal_cat (@id_func Terminal_cat)
     Terminal_obj Terminal_obj Terminal_obj
     (@defiso_to Terminal_cat Terminal_obj Terminal_obj i)
     (@defiso_from Terminal_cat Terminal_obj Terminal_obj i);
assert [K : Cat] (x y : τ (Obj K)) (f : τ (Hom K x y))
 (i : τ (@DefIso Terminal_cat Terminal_obj Terminal_obj)) ⊢
 @fapp0 Terminal_cat Terminal_cat
   (ts_constant_map K x y (@defiso_to Terminal_cat Terminal_obj Terminal_obj i) f)
   (@defiso_from Terminal_cat Terminal_obj Terminal_obj i)
 ≡ @defiso_from Terminal_cat Terminal_obj Terminal_obj i;
assertnot [K : Cat] (x y : τ (Obj K)) (f : τ (Hom K x y))
 (i : τ (@DefIso Terminal_cat Terminal_obj Terminal_obj)) ⊢
 @fapp0 Terminal_cat Terminal_cat
   (ts_current_map K x y (@defiso_to Terminal_cat Terminal_obj Terminal_obj i) f)
   (@defiso_from Terminal_cat Terminal_obj Terminal_obj i)
 ≡ @fapp0 Terminal_cat Terminal_cat
   (ts_constant_map K x y (@defiso_to Terminal_cat Terminal_obj Terminal_obj i) f)
   (@defiso_from Terminal_cat Terminal_obj Terminal_obj i);
